keyTooltip.text:
在打出一次攻击后，阿克尚将进行一次额外的射击，造成@SecondAutoDamage@物理伤害。阿克尚可以取消这次射击来转而获得在@HasteDuration@秒里持续衰减的@ASModdedMS@移动速度。

来自攻击或技能的每第三次命中会造成额外@PassiveProcDamage@魔法伤害。如果目标是英雄，阿克尚还会获得@TotalShieldAmount@护盾值，持续@ShieldDuration@秒(@PassiveCooldown@秒冷却时间)。

keyTooltipExtended.text:
{{Spell_AkshanPassive_Tooltip}}
第二次攻击可以暴击并且暴击的效能为@SecondAutoCritRatio*100@%。
第二次攻击对小兵造成100%总攻击力的伤害。
第一次攻击的移动速度的收益率为100%攻击速度。

keySummary.text:
来自阿克尚攻击或技能的每第三次命中会造成额外伤害，并且如果目标是英雄还会为他提供一层护盾。

在阿克尚攻击时，他会进行一次额外的射击，来造成较少伤害。如果他取消掉了这次额外射击，那么他会转而获得移动速度。

officialEvidence.name: Dirty Fighting
officialEvidence.description:
Every three hits from Akshan's Attacks and Abilities deals bonus damage and grants him a Shield if the target was a champion.

When Akshan Attacks, he fires an additional Attack for reduced damage. If he cancels the additional Attack, he instead gains Move Speed.

keyTooltip.text:
第一段施放：阿克尚发射一个钩爪，吸附在命中的第一个地形上。

第二段施放：阿克尚在地形附近摆荡，朝相距最近的敌人进行快速射击，每次射击造成@DamageToDeal@物理伤害。

与一名敌方英雄或地形产生碰撞，会提前结束摆荡。

keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine.text:

伤害获得提升，数额相当于@AttackSpeedCoefficient*100@%额外攻击速度。
攻击可以暴击，造成@CriticalCalc@物理伤害。

keySummary.text: 阿克尚发射一个钩爪来吸附住地形，然后围绕它进行摆荡，在摆荡时快速朝相距最近的敌人开火。他可以提前从绳索上荡下来，或在与一名敌方英雄或地形产生碰撞时落下。

officialEvidence.name: Heroic Swing
officialEvidence.description: Akshan fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy while swinging. He can jump off early or gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain.
officialEvidence.tooltip:
First Cast: Akshan fires a grappling hook, attaching to the first terrain hit.

Second Cast: Akshan swings around the terrain, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy for {{ damagetodeal }} physical damage per shot.

Third Cast: Akshan dives off the rope, firing a final shot.

Colliding with an enemy Champion or terrain ends the swing early.

Champion takedowns refresh this Ability's Cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

keyTooltip.text:
贝蕾亚跃向一个单位，将其晕眩@StunDuration@秒，造成@TotalDamage@物理伤害和持续@ShredDuration@秒的@ShredPercent*100@%护甲削减与魔抗削减。

如果贝蕾亚在血莽期间对一个小兵或野怪施放这个技能，那么她会停止将英雄作为优先目标。

Briar will stop prioritizing champions if she casts this Ability on a minion or monster during Blood Frenzy.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

keyTooltip.text:
贝蕾亚跳跃并进入一种血莽状态，自我嘲讽至相距最近的那个敌人，持续@BerserkDuration@秒，优先以英雄为目标。在血莽状态下，她获得@BerserkAS*100@%攻击速度和@BerserkMS*100@%移动速度，并且她的攻击会对目标四周的敌人们造成@TotalAoEDamage@物理伤害。

贝蕾亚可以再次施放这个技能来强化她的下一次攻击。这次攻击造成@TotalAttackBonusDamage@ + @TotalAttackPercentMissingHealth@%已损失生命值的物理伤害并为贝蕾亚提供@AttackMaxHPHeal@+@AttackHealPercent*100@%已造成伤害值的治疗效果。

keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine.text:
噬咬会对小兵和野怪造成@MonsterAndMinionPercentMod*100@%提升伤害(至多为@MaxMonsterDamage@已损失生命值伤害)。
这个技能不会移除或替代{{Spell_BriarR_Name}}的强化版血莽。

keySummary.text:
贝蕾亚向前跳跃并击碎她的囚枷，进入一种【血莽】状态来使她无休止地追击相距最近的那个敌人（优先以英雄为目标）。在【血莽】状态下，她的攻击速度和移动速度获得提升，并且她的攻击会在她目标四周的一个区域内造成伤害。

贝蕾亚可以在【血莽】状态下再次激活这个技能，来让她的下一次攻击噬咬她的目标，造成基于目标已损失生命值的额外伤害，并且基于她造成的伤害来为她提供治疗效果。

officialEvidence.name: Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack
officialEvidence.description:
Briar leaps forward and shatters her pillory, entering a Blood Frenzy that causes her to relentlessly pursue the nearest enemy (prioritizing champions). While frenzied, she gains increased Attack Speed and Move Speed, and her attacks deal damage in an area around her target.

Briar can reactivate this ability while frenzied to take a CHOMP out of her target on her next attack, dealing additional damage based on their missing Health, and healing Briar based on the damage she deals.
officialEvidence.tooltip:
Briar leaps and enters a Blood Frenzy, self-taunting to the nearest enemy for {{ berserkduration }} seconds, prioritizing Champions. While in Blood Frenzy she gains {{ berserkas*100 }}% Attack Speed and {{ berserkms*100 }}% Move Speed, and her Attacks deal {{ totalaoedamage }} physical damage to enemies surrounding her target.

Briar can Recast this Ability to empower her next Attack. It deals {{ totalattackbonusdamage }} + {{ totalattackpercentmissinghealth }}% missing Health physical damage and heals Briar for {{ attackmaxhpheal }} + {{ attackhealpercent*100 }}% of the damage dealt.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

keyTooltip.text:
开始蓄力：贝蕾亚移除血莽并聚集能量，获得@DRPercent@%伤害减免并在1秒里持续获得共@PercentMaxHPHeal@治疗效果。

释放：贝蕾亚释放一次吼叫，基于蓄力时间造成至多@Damage@魔法伤害，以及持续@SlowDuration@秒的@SlowPercent*100@%减速。在完全蓄力后，吼叫会击退敌人们，对那些与墙体碰撞的敌人造成@WallHitDamage@魔法伤害和@WallStunDuration@秒晕眩。

keySummary.text: 贝蕾亚重新集中她的意志，移除【血莽】并将能量引导为一次强力吼叫，对敌人造成伤害和减速。在蓄力时，她获得伤害减免并回复一部分最大生命值。一次完全蓄力的吼叫会将敌人们击退，对那些与墙体碰撞的敌人造成额外伤害和晕眩。

officialEvidence.name: Chilling Scream
officialEvidence.description: Briar refocuses her mind, removing Blood Frenzy and channeling energy into a powerful scream that damages and slows enemies. While charging, she takes reduced damage and heals for a portion of her max Health. A fully charged scream knocks foes back, dealing additional damage and stunning those who collide with a wall.
officialEvidence.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Briar removes Blood Frenzy and gathers energy, gaining {{ drpercent }}% damage reduction and restoring {{ percentmaxhpheal }} Health over 1 second.

Release: Briar unleashes a scream that deals up to {{ damage }} magic damage based on time charged, and Slows by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. When fully charged, the scream Knocks Back enemies, dealing {{ wallhitdamage }} magic damage to those who hit a wall and Stunning them for {{ wallstunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

keyTooltip.text: 贝蕾亚踢出她的囚枷中的血石并飞到被它命中的第一个英雄的位置，将这个英雄标记为她的猎物。在着陆时，她对附近的一切造成<magicDamage>@Damage@魔法伤害</magicDamage>并使那些并非她猎物的敌人们<status>逃跑</status>@FearDuration@秒。她随后会进入一个强化版<keywordMajor>血莽</keywordMajor>状态并将追击她的猎物直至阵亡才罢休。在此期间，她获得@TotalResists@<scaleArmor>护甲</scaleArmor> 和<scaleMR>魔法抗性</scaleMR>、@LifeStealPercent*100@%生命偷取和额外的<speed>@ExtraMoveSpeedPercent*100@%移动速度</speed>。

keySummary.text: 贝蕾亚踢出她的囚枷中的血石，让被它命中的第一个英雄成为她的猎物。她随后会径直走向该目标，在抵达目标处时恐惧周围的其它敌人们，并进入一个彻底血狂的状态。她将追击她的猎物直至阵亡才罢休，获得【血莽】的助益以及额外的护甲、魔抗、生命偷取和移动速度。

officialEvidence.name: Certain Death
officialEvidence.description: Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone, marking the first champion it hits as her prey. She then beelines straight to them, fearing other surrounding enemies upon arriving at her target, and enters a state of complete hemomania. She will pursue her prey until death, gaining the benefits of Blood Frenzy as well as additional Armor, Magic Resistance, Life Steal, and Move Speed.
officialEvidence.tooltip: Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone and flies to the location of the first champion it hits, marking them as her prey. On landing, she deals <magicDamage>{{ damage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to everything nearby and causes enemies who are not her prey to <status>Flee</status> for {{ fearduration }} seconds. She then enters an empowered <keywordMajor>Blood Frenzy</keywordMajor> and will pursue her prey until death. During this time, she gains {{ totalresists }} <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>, {{ lifestealpercent*100 }}% Lifesteal, and an additional <speed>{{ extramovespeedpercent*100 }}% Move Speed</speed>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
